cx-01-c1.text: Eric W. Weisstein. Argand Diagram. MathWorld, Wolfram Research.
cx-01-c1.quote: An Argand diagram is a plot of complex numbers as points in the complex plane.
cx-01-c1.claim: That flat map of numbers is called the Argand plane, or the complex plane.

cx-01-c3.text: Jay Abramson (2021). Precalculus 2e, 8.5 Polar Form of Complex Numbers. OpenStax, Rice University.
cx-01-c3.quote: Notice that the product calls for multiplying the moduli and adding the angles.
cx-01-c3.claim: In polar form, z_1 · z_2 means multiplying the moduli and adding the arguments, so multiplication rotates and scales.
